column1: 睡,睡觉|Both mean to sleep; 睡觉 is the verb-object form.
说,说话|Both mean to speak or talk.
见,看见|Both mean to see.
学,学习,读书|All three are about studying.
哪儿,哪里|Both mean "where".
这儿,这里,这边|All mean "here".
那儿,那里,那边|All mean "there".
星期日,星期天|Two names for Sunday.
半,一半|Both mean half.
一些,些,有些|All mean "some".
一点儿,有点儿|Both mean a little.
中文,汉语|Both mean the Chinese language.
商店,店|Both mean a shop or store.
元,块|Both are the unit of Chinese money (yuan).
好看,漂亮|Both mean good-looking or pretty.
孩子,小朋友|Both mean a child.
病,生病|Both are about being ill.
工作,上班|Both are about working.
没关系,没事|Both mean "it's okay".
很,非常,太,真|All are degree words meaning very or really.
也,还|Both can mean "also".
在,正在|Both can mean "in the process of".
想,要|Both can mean to want.
想,觉得|Both can mean to think or feel.
知道,认识|Both are ways of knowing.
喂,你好|Both are greetings, 喂 is used on the phone.
问,请问|Both are about asking.
你,您|"You", 您 is polite.
早上,上午|Both are the morning.
晚上,晚|Both are about evening or late.
天,日|Both mean day.
日,号|Both name the day of the month.
电话,手机|Both are phones.
多少,几|Both mean "how many".
小,少|Both mean little or small in amount.
喜欢,爱|Both are about liking or loving.
哪,哪个|Both mean "which".
这,这个|Both mean "this".
那,那个|Both mean "that".
饭,米饭|Both can mean rice or a meal.
但,但是|Both mean "but"; 但是 is the fuller, more common form.
高兴,快乐|Both mean happy; 快乐 is also used in greetings like 生日快乐.
有意思,好玩儿|Both mean fun or interesting; 好玩儿 is more about play and fun.
孩子,小孩儿|Both mean child; 小孩儿 is more colloquial and usually means a young child.
跟,和|Both can mean "with" or "and"; 跟 sounds a little more spoken.
送,给|Both can mean to give; 送 is giving as a gift (or seeing someone off).
说,告诉|Both are about telling; 告诉 needs the person who is told.
帮,帮忙|Both mean to help; 帮忙 is the verb-object form.
跑,跑步|Both mean to run; 跑步 is the verb-object form (to jog).
游,游泳|Both can mean to swim; 游泳 is the usual word.
考,考试|Both are about taking an exam; 考试 is also the exam itself.
走,走路|Both mean to walk; 走路 is the verb-object form.
票,门票,机票|All are tickets; 门票 is for entry, 机票 is for flights.
站,车站|Both can mean a station or stop; 车站 is a bus or train station.
小时候,从小|Both are about childhood; 从小 means "since childhood".
为什么,怎么|Both ask why; 为什么 asks the reason, 怎么 can also ask how.
商场,商店|Both are places to shop; 商场 is a big mall, 商店 a shop.
外面,外边|Both mean outside.
开,打开|Both mean to open; 打开 stresses opening something up or turning it on.
事情,事|Both mean a matter or thing; 事情 is the fuller form.
那么,那样|Both mean "like that"; 那么 is also used before adjectives (那么高).
这么,这样|Both mean "like this"; 这么 is also used before adjectives (这么高).
